text: I can give Marta plain words, yes. I take the bag by the sound end and set out with Wren for the Halloran steading. The ford was under water on the way out, so I tell her about the ridge road and keep to her lantern and her pace.
intent: Take Wren's bag, agree to speak honestly, and travel with her to the Hallorans by a passable route, staying together.
